## nomos-decision-hub 2.0.2 Changelog

- Added sample environment configuration file: `.env.example`
- No changes to code or runtime behavior; this release helps users set up required environment variables more easily.

Sync engine to NOMOS 0.7.0: ten-operator cognitive audit kernel; second-order causality (interaction layer, formal convergence, LLM permission gate); enterprise control plane (event store, tenant isolation, OIDC, KMS signing, rate limiting, observability); v0.7 meta-causal ledger terminology (breaking). Bundles src/, LICENSE, CHANGELOG, GLOSSARY, v0.4/enterprise/verification/compliance docs, refreshed OpenAPI and examples. Fixes placeholder docker-compose, stale five-operator text, and missing LICENSE.
Full English localization of SKILL.md, international release
Added English translation, minor documentation improvements

- Added capability and privilege disclosure section, outlining explicit runtime requirements for network, environment variables, database, and port binding.
- Refined trigger conditions: now only activates when users explicitly reference NOMOS 决策引擎, Decision-Hub, second_perspective, or specific output artifacts (e.g., 密封报告规范).
- Clarified description around enterprise-level deployment requirements and scope of support.
- Documentation file changes: added SKILL.md.bak backup, removed legacy skill-card.md.
- General content streamlined; removed broad auto-trigger keywords to prevent unwanted activation.
v2.0: sealed report spec (P0) + online audit engine alignment (P0) + decision scenario library (P1) + multilingual export (P2) + homepage fix

- Major update: English rewrite of documentation and user guidance.
- All core capabilities, usage instructions, and deterministic contract sections rewritten in English for broader accessibility.
- Descriptions updated for clarity, consistency, and improved onboarding.
- No functional/code changes—documentation and communication improvement only.

- No changes detected in this version.
- Version number updated to 1.1.1; no modifications to files or documentation.

Version 1.0.1 — Major update and restructuring

- Migrated core documentation from references/ to docs/ and root directory; removed redundant reference materials and scripts.
- Added new Chinese-language skill description and usage docs, emphasizing compliance, causal analysis, stress testing, and governance.
- Provided public samples and configuration files (examples/market_entry.json, docker-compose.yml, openapi-action.yaml).
- Enhanced enterprise deployment guidance, including Docker instructions.
- Cleaned up audit report, architecture, and compliance documentation for clarity and onboarding.
- Replaced old manifest with BRANCH_MANIFEST.md and updated README for easier project entry.

- Initial release of NOMOS Decision-Hub skill, bundling methodology, architecture docs, IMDA audit report, and runnable research examples.
- Enables deterministic, transparent, and auditable decision-making with causal counterfactual analysis and compliance-grade audit trails (IMDA AI Verify style).
- Supports scenario stress-testing, algorithm-ledger verification, human-in-the-loop governance, and sensitivity/robustness analysis.
- Includes onboarding instructions, Python API, CLI demos, and deployment guidance (Docker/PostgreSQL/OIDC integration).
- Skill is for individual non-commercial research and learning; full engine must be installed separately.
